name: Pismo Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Pismo Beach?
answer_short: Yes, with the California caps. In Pismo Beach, a golf cart may use a street posted 25 mph or less in a business or residence district. An LSV may use a road posted 35 mph or less. US 101 is closed to both.

rules.rule: Golf carts on highways posted 25 mph or less in a business or residence district
LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; they may cross faster roads at intersections
Freeway; no golf carts or LSVs

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Pismo Beach?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart downtown in Pismo Beach?
faq.a: On a street posted 25 mph or less in a business or residence district, yes.

faq.q: Can an LSV drive on Price Street?
faq.a: Only where it is posted 35 mph or less. Faster stretches are closed.
